method.step: Enumerate every contiguous run of `min_stmts` or more statements in every block in the codebase.

Normalize the identifiers in each run (every snake_case value name it mentions, plus generics and lifetimes, renamed to placeholders by first-seen order) and bucket runs that share a canonical form; a bucket with 2+ members is a duplicate group. See desc.xml for what the equivalence does and does not claim.
Suppress dominated spans: a smaller fragment that only appears nested inside a larger, equally-or-more-duplicated fragment is dropped, so only maximal clones are reported.
